prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1077; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the lower center and the left taillight assembly is shattered, with scuffing and paint transfer running along the left quarter panel. The damage lines up with the low-speed impact described in the loss report, and the pattern of contact points is consistent with a vehicle backing into or being struck by a stationary object in a parking lot. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account. The proposed repair covers replacing the bumper cover, the taillight assembly, and refinishing the left quarter panel, with labor hours that fit the scope of this work. The invoices submitted so far show each line item billed once, with no duplicate charges. Recommend approval of the estimate as written.
